name: shape-artwork
title: Shape artwork
description: An original SVG silhouette with a cast shadow and a rotated rear outline. The same vector layers power its live preview and standalone SVG export.

props.name: filled
props.description: False draws the foreground as an outline.

props.name: shadowAngle
props.description: Direction of the cast shadow, clockwise from the right.

props.name: echoAngle
props.description: Rear outline rotation relative to the foreground.

props.name: ambient
props.description: Opt-in ambient contour motion. It pauses offscreen and in quiet motion modes.

props.name: morphTo
props.description: Compatible signature silhouette used as the far end of the living contour.

props.name: motionDelay
props.description: Staggers compositions without relying on render-time randomness.
